name: CI: Lint CSS (Stylelint)
description: GitHub Actions workflow that calls rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows ci-lint-css.yml. Runs Stylelint over changed files in a PR, or the whole project on push. Calls `@v1` by default.

inputs.description: Tag or ref of rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows to call. Pin a major tag such as `v1`, never a branch: branches move or get deleted.
Node.js version. Leave empty to use the project's .nvmrc, which the shared workflow reads.
